hooks.text: The Milky Way's black hole erupted 350 years ago.
Our galaxy's central black hole is not as quiet as it looks.
Four million suns of gravity erupted 350 years ago.

title: The Milky Way's Black Hole Erupted 350 Years Ago
description: Astronomers discovered an ancient X-ray echo revealing that the Milky Way's central black hole erupted 350 years ago. The supermassive monster released a million times more energy than it does today.

beats.text: Then astronomers found X-rays echoing off a nearby gas cloud.

beats.text: The echo revealed a blast one million times brighter than now.
